top_signals.title: Goldman’s Bell Backs German Stocks Despite Rising Political Risk
top_signals.summary: Germany’s escalating political turmoil needn’t spell trouble for the country’s main stock market, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s Sharon Bell, who says the DAX is largely shielded from domestic risks.

top_signals.title: Pakistan Secures Second Qatari LNG Cargo Through Hormuz After Iran Deal
top_signals.summary: Pakistan is set to receive an LNG cargo from Qatar after having negotiated with Iran the safe passage of the shipment through the Strait of Hormuz, sources familiar with the deal told Bloomberg on Monday. This would be the second Qatari LNG cargo that the energy crisis-stricken Pakistan would receive in September after some carriers managed to move out of the Persian Gulf early this month. The latest LNG shipment cleared the Strait of Hormuz this weekend and is set to arrive in Pakistan by Tuesday, per ship-tracking data compiled by Bloomberg.…

top_signals.summary: Though the Crossmint-powered memecoin sales are still live on both apps, Visa's grace period is expected to end next week, per the report.

top_signals.title: United States on track for record crude oil production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. crude oil production will average 13.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 13.7 million b/d set in 2025, in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).

top_signals.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
top_signals.summary: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry Hub.

top_signals.title: European Commission set to push social media restrictions, safety requirements into law
top_signals.summary: The proposal, known as the EU KIDS Act, would block social media platforms from offering accounts to children younger than 13 and establish a bloc-wide minimum age of 15 for account creation.
